overall_summary: The channel shows very low overall view counts across all recent uploads, indicating low reach and high initial testing variance. Confidence is low due to insufficient engagement data, requiring a controlled exploration strategy focusing on relatable phone-related hooks and high-retention storytelling loops.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos with hooks about saved names and old numbers ('आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है', 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया कभी') achieved slightly higher views (20 and 5).
winning_patterns.action: Continue utilizing tactile, everyday smartphone habits as entry points.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' or 'घंटों से वो ऑनलाइन दिख रहा है' underperformed (4-12 views), showing fatigue with overly broad or cliché statements.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract time-based statements and focus on physical, tangible objects or micro-actions.
